title: Content Producer, Apprentice
description:
Job Summary 
 Role Title: Apprentice - Assistant Project Manager Tier: IC10 - Department/Division: Higher Education - Location: Hybrid - Employment Type: Full-time - Duration: 12 months - Target Start The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager for the Higher Education International Division will help to ensure the assembly, execution, and maintenance of major products according to specified objectives - budget, schedule, and adherence to quality standards. The Print/Digital Assistant Project Manager is part of the broader team that executes annual plans and organizes and prioritizes tasks and teams to ensure delivery. You will work with authors, Pearson Content and Digital Producers, Quality Assurance (QA), Accessibility, Rights and Permissions (R&P) and vendor partners to deliver stable, high-quality products to improve learner outcomes and maximize instructor impact. You will also manage production schedules for print and digital assets. This role is ideal for a fresher or early-career professional who is eager to learn project management, risk assessment and mitigation, and digital product creation in the higher education space. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Content production of selected print, digital, and supplemental content. Production of digital courseware content that will be used in both print and digital delivery. Maintain legacy data on a vast number of series-specific titles, including print books and editorial supplements, while at the same time helping to guide the list through the transition to a nextGen digital format. Learn how to act as point-person throughout entire lifecycle process, respond to queries from various stakeholders, serve as knowledge resource for Portfolio team. Learn how to provide high-level management of a large number of primary authors, development editors, technical editors, supplement authors, copyeditors, and freelance project managers. Negotiate rates, prioritize work. Learn how to provide communication across cross-functional teams. Includes initiating launch meetings, serving as meeting moderator, and maintaining status reports. Coordinating and keeping track of budgets in all the projects. Learn to drive creation of project schedules; enforce adherence; provide accountability charter for delays. Serve as liaison with Rights and Permission team; ensure quality of coverage; escalate any schedule delays or budget concerns. Identify and manage vendors to schedule, budget, and quality compliance; provide feedback on performance. Enforce system maintenance and data integrity of records; oversee invoice processing and reconciliation. Support in contributing to cover and internal design process. 
 
 Desirable Skills and Attributes 
 Ability to think and act independently to seek out resolutions and problem-solve on a daily basis. Ability to influence and negotiate where necessary with peers, project team, sponsors/stakeholders, and other internal teams as needed. Ability to respond confidently to conflicts and manage situations positively, proactively escalating ongoing issues and showing solid judgment. Demonstrates highly active ownership of projects, possesses ability to proactively assess and mitigate risk, and actively poses solutions to problems. Communicates effectively (written and verbally) with peers, project team, and sponsors/stakeholders. Shows strong command of the English language. Able to assess and manage across a full project breadth and depth, ensuring a successful delivery of products. Ability to work with cross-functional teams delivering both digital and print product outputs. Diligent attention to detail. Strong organization skills: Self-organizing and self-motivating. Strong time-management abilities--organizing tasks in a logical and efficient manner allowing for multitasking and making appropriate calls on prioritization. 
 
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Bachelor's degree in any discipline. Recent graduates or candidates with less than one to three years of experience are encouraged to apply. Must meet requirements under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and be registered on the NATS portal. Must be legally eligible to work in India. 
 
 Experience You Will Gain 
 Practical exposure to Project Management operations, scheduling and budgeting. Hands-on experience in risk assessment and mitigation, and professional communication. Experience in creating and sharing schedules using Smartsheets. Understanding of how digital learning products are built and created. Opportunity to work with Product, Content Solutions, QA, and R&P teams in a professional business environment. 
 
 Work Schedule 
 This is a full-time apprenticeship from Monday to Friday, approximately 40 hours per week. The role involves working across several geographies and requires occasional flexibility in supporting the business beyond regular office hours. 
 
 Location 
 Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India - Hybrid

title: Hr Executive And Recruiter
description: About the Role We are looking for a proactive and organized HR Executive to join our Group HR team. The role will primarily focus on end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition across multiple business verticals within the Group, along with supporting various HR operations and employee engagement activities. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, good sourcing capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple requirements simultaneously. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Primary Responsibility Manage end-to-end recruitment for assigned positions across Group Companies. Understand manpower requirements and prepare/coordinate Job Descriptions (JDs) with the respective departments. Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, social media, recruitment agencies, and other channels . Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate assessments. Conduct preliminary HR interviews and coordinate technical/functional interviews with hiring managers. Maintain regular follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Coordinate interview schedules and ensure timely feedback from interview panels. Manage candidate negotiation and offer coordination in consultation with the reporting manager. Coordinate offer release, pre-joining follow-ups, and joining formalities . Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and provide regular recruitment MIS and status reports . Build and maintain a pipeline of suitable candidates for recurring and critical positions. Support bulk hiring, campus recruitment, walk-in drives, and other hiring initiatives whenever required. Ensure positions are closed within the agreed Turnaround Time (TAT) . 2. HR Operations Support day-to-day HR operations across Group Companies. Coordinate employee joining, onboarding, induction, and exit formalities . Maintain and update employee records and HR documentation. Support attendance, leave, payroll inputs, and other employee-related HR processes. Assist in maintaining personnel files and ensuring HR documentation is complete and up to date. Coordinate issuance of HR-related letters and documents such as appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, relieving letters, etc. Assist in implementing HR policies and procedures. 3. Employee Engagement & HR Support Support employee engagement activities, events, celebrations, and internal initiatives. Assist in employee communication and coordination on HR-related matters. Support employee grievance handling and escalate concerns to the reporting manager where required. Assist in organizing training and development programs. Support performance management and appraisal-related activities. 4. HR MIS & Documentation Maintain accurate recruitment and HR databases. Prepare regular Recruitment MIS, joining reports, hiring status reports, and other HR reports . Track recruitment metrics such as: Open Positions Profiles Sourced Profiles Shortlisted Interviews Scheduled Offers Released Offers Accepted Positions Closed Time-to-Hire Ensure confidentiality and accuracy of employee and candidate information. 5. Other HR Responsibilities Coordinate with department heads and business teams regarding manpower requirements. Assist the HR team in implementing new HR processes and initiatives. Support statutory compliance and other HR activities as assigned. Perform any other HR-related responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager. Required Skills & Competencies Strong communication and interpersonal skills . Good knowledge of recruitment and sourcing techniques . Ability to effectively screen and assess candidates. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously. Good negotiation and candidate management skills. Strong organizational and time-management abilities. Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets, MS Office, and recruitment platforms . Ability to maintain recruitment trackers and prepare HR MIS. Good understanding of basic HR processes and practices. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline . MBA/PGDM in Human Resources will be an added advantage. Preferred Experience 1–3 years of experience in HR / Recruitment / Talent Acquisition. Experience handling multiple vacancies across different functions or business verticals will be preferred. Candidates with experience in a group/company environment or multi-industry recruitment will be an advantage.

description:
**Walk\-in Interview Drive (12 September 2026\)** 




 We are hiring experienced Architecture, Engineering, and MEPF professionals for four role groups. Review the opportunities below, then see the detailed responsibilities and qualifications for each role.
 


1. **Senior Project Engineer (MEPF/Structure) \& Senior Architect.**
2. **Assistant Project Manager/Project Manager/Senior Project Manager (MEPF, Structure \& Architecture).**
3. **Project Manager\- Architecture/Senior Architect.**
4. **Landscape Architect (Senior Architect/Project Manager)**



  





**Event Details** 




**Date:** 
 12 September 2026
 



**Time:** 
 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM
 



**Venue:** 
 14th Floor, Emaar Digital Greens, Sector 61, Gurugram
 



**Candidates are encouraged to arrive early and allow sufficient time for registration and interviews.** 




  





**1\. Senior Project Engineer (MEPF/Structure) and Senior Architect** 




**Responsibilities** 



* Participate in project management activities, BIM/VDC workflows, change orders, submittals, and other project engineering tasks.
* Undergo training \& be familiar with all GDC services related to project engineering verticals to perform tasks per highest standards required as GDC team members.
* Participate in coordination and communication with the Client’s US project managers during the daily project meetings and provide updates on their assigned tasks.
* Develop a thorough understanding of construction\-industry practices and how facilities are designed and built in Indian and international markets.
* Understanding \& prepared to work on all project engineering activities including (but not limited to) 2D overlays, submittals, change orders, estimation, etc.
* Assist the project managers on initial estimating efforts of new projects in terms of hours \& resources required for successful projects execution.
* Maintain positive working relationships with counterparts at both India \& US entities.
* Maintain thorough quality assurance / control standards \& protocols across the company and individual projects.
* Develop and lead training sessions for your team and trade partners.
* Take ownership of document management applications



**2\. Assistant Project Manager, Project Manager, or Senior Project Manager (MEPF, Structure, and Architecture)** 




**Responsibilities** 



* Supervise all activities related to project management, change orders, submittals, and other project engineering tasks.
* Directly supervise and train all team members assigned to project engineering vertically across different tiers.
* Schedule and facilitate all project meetings required to successfully coordinate work activity
* Train and develop direct reports utilizing the job and internal and external training or development opportunities.
* Have thorough knowledge of all major project issues and priorities; prepare and submit weekly job status reports.
* Maintain thorough quality assurance / control standards \& protocols across the company and individual projects.
* Provide general administrative and technical leadership for the project. Maintain all project records and monitor correspondence
* Be the primary point of contact for initial estimating efforts of new projects in terms of hours \& resources required for successful projects execution.
* Lead product development efforts for the GDC team and supervise team members involved in the phased developments of these products.
* Develop and maintain positive working relationships with counterparts at both GDC and US entities.
* Lead coordination \& communication with the GDC project managers during the daily project update meetings or when required.
* Have thorough knowledge and understanding of the services offered by GDC \& all parties involved and use them for effective project delivery.



**Basic Qualifications** 



* Undergraduate or graduate degree in engineering (civil, mechanical, or electrical), architecture, construction management, a related discipline, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* 5–8\+ years of construction experience, preferably with a reputed construction or engineering firm, including at least one year of exposure to BIM.
* Demonstrated knowledge of change order and submittals management, and general project administration.
* Demonstrated ability to read and interpret drawings and specifications.
* Computer proficient including Microsoft Office and Google Workspace products.
* Preferred – Bluebeam/On\-screen takeoffs/estimation software experience
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Interest and passion for building and industry



  





**3\. Project Manager – Architecture / Senior Architect** 




**Experience:** 
 5–15 years
 



**Job Summary** 



* Candidates should conduct all managerial tasks in technical models and deliverables to match requirements stated in the BIM Execution plan.
* Outstanding knowledge in architectural projects like residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, etc.
* Effectively managing the team.
* Demonstrated hands\-on expertise in residential, commercial, hospitality, healthcare, and other architectural project types.
* Deliver assigned project outputs within the agreed schedule.
* Provide hands\-on coaching, mentoring, and job\-shadowing opportunities to develop team members.



**Responsibilities** 



* Act as a main point of contact for BIM and related issues
* Take overall responsibility for project delivery, including coordination, schedule, quality, BIM deliverables, and issue resolution.
* Ensuring the quality
* Ensuring the BIM deliverables as set in the BIM execution plan
* Controls and updates the BIM Execution Plan when required
* Establishes processes and protocols for data exchange and user rights to maintain model integrity and validity.
* Generates and monitors schedules and milestones as agreed upon by project participants.
* Communicate with project partners to facilitate RFIs, design changes, and ensure that the model is updated based on the resolutions provided.
* Coordinates and ensures the data extraction required by the different construction trades with the design team.
* Ensures that the BIM deliverables are in line with the QA process.



 Managerial Skills
 


* Produces clash and design issues reports
* Model management and Auditing
* Monitor project quality against agreed deliverables, standards, and client requirements, and address deviations promptly.
* Ensuring the BIM deliverables as set in the BIM execution plan



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in architecture, architectural engineering, civil engineering, construction technology, or a related field from a reputed university, or an equivalent international qualification.
* 5–15 years of experience in BIM implementation, processes, and standards preferred.
* Expert knowledge of AutoCAD®, Revit Architecture, Navisworks Manage, Sketch up.
* Excellent collaborative and organizational skills with the ability to communicate effectively.



**Required Skills** 



* Planning Resources: Defining the project’s scope and determining what resources are available, estimating time and financial commitment, as well as how to monitor and report on the project’s progress.
* Assemble and lead the project team: Take ownership of assigned projects and all associated deliverables, identify opportunities for improvement, and demonstrate the ability to learn quickly.
* Time Management ‐define, schedules and accurately estimates the task duration to develop and maintain a realistic schedule.
* Quality and satisfaction: Deliver projects in accordance with agreed quality standards and client expectations.
* Manage Issues and Risk: Identifying the issues at the initial stage and giving the proper solutions for every problem during the project's execution.
* Monitoring Progress: collecting the project data to see if the project's progress is meeting what is first planned. Reallocating the resources to accommodate these changes required during the project.
* Documentation: Maintain the documentation throughout the project to be retrieved at any time.



**4\. Landscape Architect (Senior Architect / Project Manager)** 



* Lead and manage the planning, design, and delivery of high\-quality landscape architecture projects across various typologies including public realm, hospitality, residential, and urban infrastructure.
* Drive the development and management of BIM models for complex landscape projects, ensuring alignment with project objectives and digital delivery standards.
* Integrate sustainable design principles, low\-impact development strategies, and local environmental considerations into all stages of design.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders including architects, MEP engineers, civil consultants, and contractors to ensure landscape designs are seamlessly integrated into broader project frameworks.
* Maintain BIM documentation, drawing standards, LOD requirements, and ensure compliance with ISO 19650 and client\-specific BIM protocols.
* Oversee and participate in clash detection, model validation, and issue resolution through platforms like Navisworks and BIM 360\.
* Prepare and review detailed construction drawings, technical documentation, BOQs, and specifications in collaboration with support teams.
* Conduct regular project reviews, QA/QC checks, and technical workshops with teams and clients.
* Mentor and supervise junior team members, promoting knowledge sharing, skill development, and continuous improvement.
* Engage with clients for design presentations, progress updates, and technical discussions, ensuring clear communication and alignment with expectations.



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Bachelor’s degree in landscape architecture, Architecture, or a related field (Mandatory).**
* **Master’s degree in Landscape Architecture or Urban Design (Preferred).**
* Proven expertise in Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, and other BIM tools; experience with BIM 360, Enscape, Lumion, or Twin motion is advantageous.

 Krishna Transnational Marbles Private Limited

 Employee Relations & Disciplinary Support Support managers and HR leadership with employee relations matters. Assist with documentation of performance and conduct issues.  Administrative & Corporate Support Coordinate employee and corporate requirements, including business cards for U.S. office employees and AASI/DriveChoice personnel . title: Store Sales Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities 1. Sales & Target Achievement Achieve monthly and quarterly store sales targets. Drive walk-in conversions and maximise revenue per customer. Follow up consistently with all enquiries, leads and quotations. Convert high-value and customised furniture enquiries into orders. Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling across furniture and home dcor categories. Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and ensure no lead is left unattended. 2. Customer Experience Welcome and engage customers visiting the store in a professional and warm manner. Understand customers' requirements, lifestyle, budget, home size and design preferences. Recommend suitable products based on customer requirements. Explain product features, materials, craftsmanship, finishes, dimensions, customisation options and delivery timelines. Handle customer objections and negotiate effectively while maintaining Fabuliv's premium positioning. Ensure customers receive a seamless experience from enquiry to order and delivery. 3. Lead Management & Follow-ups Manage leads received through the website, phone calls, WhatsApp, social media and other channels. Maintain accurate records of all leads and follow-ups in the CRM. Ensure timely follow-up on quotations and pending decisions. Reconnect with old and dormant leads to generate additional sales. Track every lead until it is converted or formally closed. 4. Store Management Ensure the showroom is always maintained to Fabuliv's premium standards. Ensure products are properly displayed, clean and presentable. Coordinate with the visual merchandising and operations teams when required. Ensure product information and pricing displayed in the store is accurate. Maintain discipline and professionalism within the sales team. 5. Team Management Lead and motivate the store sales team. Allocate leads and customers appropriately among team members. Monitor individual sales performance and conversion ratios. Conduct regular sales reviews and provide coaching to team members. Train the team on products, materials, finishes, pricing, customisation and Fabuliv's brand story. Set daily and weekly sales priorities for the team. 6. Coordination with Internal Teams Coordinate with production, design, customer support, logistics and accounts teams to ensure smooth execution of customer orders. Communicate customised requirements accurately to the concerned teams. Follow up on production and delivery commitments where required. Escalate customer issues promptly and ensure timely resolution. 7. Reporting & MIS Prepare daily and weekly sales reports. Track store revenue, leads, conversions, average order value and pending follow-ups. Monitor lost orders and identify reasons for non-conversion. Share competitor insights and customer feedback with management. Provide regular updates on sales performance and upcoming opportunities. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The Sales Manager will be evaluated on: Monthly store sales Achievement against sales targets Lead-to-order conversion rate Walk-in conversion rate Average Order Value (AOV) Follow-up efficiency Number of repeat customers/referrals Customised order conversion Lead response time Customer satisfaction Team productivity Lost-lead percentage 
 Preferred candidate profile Must Have 3-7 years of experience in sales, preferably premium/luxury retail. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Excellent convincing and negotiation abilities. Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills. Target-oriented and commercially driven. Ability to handle high-value customers professionally. Good understanding of CRM and lead management. Comfortable working with monthly sales targets. Preferred Experience in any of the following industries will be an advantage: Luxury furniture Interior design Home dcor Modular kitchens Real estate Premium automobiles Luxury lifestyle Jewellery High-end retail Personal Attributes We are looking for someone who is: Confident and well-spoken Well-groomed and presentable Highly customer-focused Energetic and proactive Target-driven Persistent with follow-ups Good at building relationships Comfortable dealing with affluent customers A problem solver Passionate about design, furniture and interiors Capable of working independently and taking ownership

title: Front Office Executive
description:
The Front Office Executive (Operations) will be responsible for supporting the daily administrative and operational functions of the showroom. The role focuses on ensuring smooth day-to-day operations, maintaining showroom cleanliness and brand standards, managing inventory, and assisting the internal team to enhance the overall customer experience. 
 Note: This role does not include any sales-related responsibilities. 
 Key Responsibilities: 1. Operational Management: Assist in managing the day-to-day Admin operations of the showroom, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. Oversee showroom opening and closing procedures, ensuring all operational tasks are completed accurately and on time. 2. Inventory Management: Monitor and manage stationary & housekeeping inventory, ensuring demo-lifts are well maintained and displays of samples are visually appealing. 3. Showroom Presentation: Ensure the showroom is clean, organized, and visually appealing, adhering to company merchandising standards. Oversee the setup and maintenance of showroom displays, ensuring they are attractive and well-maintained. 4. Customer Service Support: • Provide support to the sales team in handling customer inquiries and ensuring a high level of customer service. Address any operational issues that may arise during the showrooms operation, ensuring prompt resolution. 5. Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate records of showroom operations, including inventory counts, client walk ins, and maintenance logs. Prepare and submit regular reports on showroom maintenance reports, inventory, and operational issues to the reporting manager. 6. Maintenance and Facilities Management: • Coordinate with maintenance personnel and vendors to ensure the showroom is well maintained and all equipment is in working order. Handle minor repairs and troubleshooting of showroom equipment and fixtures. 7. Compliance and Safety: Ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, maintaining a safe environment for staff and customers. Conduct regular safety inspections and address any hazards or safety concerns promptly. 
 Qualifications: Bachelors degree (preferred in any field, commonly in Commerce, Business Administration, or Arts), or Diploma holders in Hospitality, Front Office, or Retail Management. 
 Experience: • 0-2 years for entry-level FOEs (Freshers can also be considered if they have strong communication and grooming skills). • Experience in similar roles in retail, hospitality, or front-desk/customer-facing positions is highly preferred. Key Skills Required: • Excellent communication skills (Fluency in English and regional language). • Customer service orientation. • Good interpersonal skills and presentation. • Basic computer knowledge (MS Office, email handling). • Ability to handle walk-in clients, coordinate with internal teams, and manage basic administrative tasks. 
 Grooming & Personality: • Presentable appearance, neat grooming. • Polite and professional behaviour. • Ability to multitask and stay composed under pressure.

This is a semi-voice role involving a combination of data processing, billing validation, email communication, and outbound/inbound interactions with utility providers, clients, and internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely resident billing. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Utility Bill Processing & Data Management: Retrieve utility bills from provider websites, portals, and client submissions. Download, validate, upload, and archive utility bills following established procedures. Verify account information, service periods, billing amounts, and resident data. Maintain audit-ready documentation and billing records. Perform resident data validation including move-ins, move-outs, transfers, and account updates.

Follow up on pending utility bills, account information, and billing discrepancies. Communicate billing status updates, missing documentation, and issue resolutions professionally. Handle inbound and outbound calls related to billing inquiries and operational support. Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate teams for resolution. 
 C. Billing Validation & Reconciliation: Review pre-bills, utility charges, statement data, and occupancy records for accuracy. Investigate billing discrepancies, charge variances, and exception reports. Perform data comparisons and reconciliations using Excel and operational systems. Ensure all billing exceptions are resolved before final approval. 
 D. title: Talent Branding Specialist
description:
****Job Requirements****
 At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
   

  

****Job Requirements****
 We're currently seeking a dynamic Talent Branding Specialist. You will play a crucial role in shaping our company's employer brand, ensuring that we attract and retain top\-tier talent. This position requires a combination of innovative thinking, analytical skills, and a profound understanding of contemporary recruitment strategies.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
* Create and implement our talent branding strategy, ensuring its alignment with our overall business objectives.
* Collaborate closely with our recruitment and marketing teams to develop compelling content that positions our company as an employer of choice.
* Analyze and provide reports on the effectiveness of our talent branding initiatives, offering data\-driven recommendations for enhancement.
* Stay up\-to\-date with industry trends and best practices in employer branding, incorporating them into our strategy as applicable.
* Run campaigns, walkin drives and events to promote hiring.
* Conceptualise and create training video content and marketing video content.


 We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
   

  

 We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference\-makers in our workplace.

title: Talent Acquisition Intern - Founder's Office
description:
For the kind of soul who finds energy in finding people, not just helping them get the job done.
 



 Recruiting is one of those crafts where most people are bad, very few are great, and the great ones quietly run the most important function in any growing company. Without the right people walking in, nothing else scales. Without speed, the right people walk out before they walk in.
 



 We are not great at this yet. We get hundreds of applicants per role, the leadership reviews most of them, and good candidates slip through because nobody got back to them in time. That is the gap this role is built to close.
 



  





**About The Test Tribe** 




 We are the world's largest Software Testing community turned Workforce Development Startup. 170K\+ members. 130\+ countries. 45\+ global chapters. Close to 1000 events done so far, including 30\+ large\-scale global conferences. We hold a high quality bar and we keep raising it. Products, services, flagship events, all of it.
 



 About the Role
 



 This is a Talent Acquisition internship role inside the Founder's Office.
 



 You work directly with the founder and leadership on every open role at TTT. Right now that means Business Development, Community, Founder's Office, and Operations hires. Tomorrow it will mean more.
 



 If you want a role that compresses 2 years of recruiting experience and learning into 3\-6 months, this is that role. And you can ask this to quite a few interns who walked the same path at TTT.
 



 Stipend: ₹10,000 to ₹20,000/month, based on what you bring to the table readily.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Source candidates daily across LinkedIn, Apollo, Internshala, Naukri, and college networks for 3 to 5 open roles at any time
* Run first\-pass screens on every applicant. Tag Good Fit, Maybe, Not a Fit. Surface the top 5 to 10 per role to the founder, weekly
* Own outbound cold emails, calls to candidates we want, not just inbound applicants we got
* Manage candidate communication end\-to\-end. Scheduling, follow\-ups, no\-show recovery, post\-interview feedback
* Own the recruiting tracker. One clean funnel dashboard per role, weekly Monday report
* Run employer branding lite. Careers page hygiene, candidate testimonial posts, founder\-led hiring posts on LinkedIn
* Daily leadership sync to share what is working, what is not, where the funnel is leaking



  





**Must\-Haves** 



* Strong written English, you will be writing cold InMails to VPs and warm replies to interns in the same hour
* Comfort with LinkedIn, Sheets/Notion, Calendly
* High ownership and speed, recruiting is a daily numbers game, not a weekly review
* Discipline in follow\-ups and documentation
* High reliability, should never need a follow\-up twice
* Working from Office, Baner, Pune, 5 days a week



  





**Nice To Have** 



* Prior sourcing or recruiting reps (college fest hiring, club hiring, internship hiring, freelance recruiting, any)
* Familiarity with Apollo, LinkedIn Recruiter, or any ATS
* Interest in B2B, SaaS, or startup ecosystem



  





**What You Get** 



* Speed: Learn high\-quality recruiting at pace
* Founder access: Daily, not weekly. Feedback in hours, not days
* Real ownership: You will close at least one hire in the first 6 weeks
* Tools provided: LinkedIn Recruiter, Apollo, ChatGPT Pro, Claude, Zoho, Calendly, Notion
* Good news: We don't treat interns as interns
* Bad news: We don't treat interns as interns



  





**Hiring Process** 



* 20\-minute screening call
* 30\-minute assignment (write 2 outbound messages and a candidate ranking) OR a video pitch on why you are the ideal candidate for this role
* 30\-minute founder round
* Offer or result within 3 working days



  





 This role is for a high\-ownership, structured, fast\-moving person who wants to learn recruiting as a craft, not as a checkbox. If that sounds like you, apply.

Who We Are
Teleminds Infotech Pvt. Ltd., incorporated in 2012, is a leading Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) company serving a diverse portfolio of clients across Australia, particularly in the telecom and energy sectors. With its head office in Kolkata and an additional office in Delhi, Teleminds has grown to a strength of 600+ employees.
We combine advanced technology, industry expertise, and customer-centric solutions to help businesses overcome complex challenges, enhance productivity, and accelerate growth. Our commitment to excellence extends to both our clients and employees, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment.
Role Overview
We are looking for a highly motivated and results-driven Telecom Lead Generation Specialist to engage with prospective customers in the Australian telecom market. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying customer requirements, generating qualified leads, scheduling appointments or transfers for the sales team, and contributing to campaign growth through effective customer engagement and lead qualification.
 
Key Responsibilities
 Contact prospective customers and generate qualified leads for telecom products and services 
in the Australian market. Engage customers through outbound and inbound interactions to assess their telecommunications 
needs. Educate customers about available internet, broadband, mobile, NBN, and telecom solutions. Qualify leads based on campaign criteria and transfer or schedule appointments for the sales team. Maintain a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities to support business growth. Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly lead generation targets and KPIs. Deliver a positive and professional customer experience during every interaction and build report and establish trust with prospective customers through effective communication. Address customer questions and provide accurate information regarding telecom products and services. Ensure all customer interactions reflect the company's commitment to service excellence with Australian telecommunications regulations, company policies, and campaign requirements. Follow approved scripts, call guides, disclosure requirements, and quality standards. Obtain and document customer consent where required. Maintain accurate customer records and update CRM systems promptly. Participate in quality monitoring, coaching sessions, and performance reviews. Adhere to data privacy, confidentiality, and ethical communication standards. Consistently meet or exceed lead generation, productivity, and quality targets. Maintain high standards of attendance, adherence, and call quality. Collaborate with Team Leaders and Management to achieve campaign objectives. 
 
Pre-Requisites
 Minimum 1-3 years of experience in Lead Generation, Telecom Sales, Customer Acquisition, BPO Sales, or Appointment Setting. Experience working on Australian telecom campaigns will be highly preferred. Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Strong lead qualification and customer engagement abilities. Experience with CRM systems, dialers, and lead management tools. Goal-oriented mindset with a passion for achieving targets. Ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment. We are looking for enthusiastic, detail-oriented, and analytical candidates to join our team as Geospatial Analysts (POI Mapping) . This opportunity is ideal for fresh graduates who are passionate about digital maps, location-based services, GIS, navigation, and data analysis . The role involves working on Point of Interest (POI) information across digital mapping platforms while ensuring high levels of accuracy, quality, and customer experience. General Guidelines Registrations will be processed on a first-come, first-served basis. Participation is limited to the first 350 eligible candidates reporting between 09:00 AM and 10:00 AM. Personal laptops, tablets, or other electronic devices are not permitted during the interview process. Candidates are advised to carry a mobile charger as the interview and assessment process may extend throughout the day. Applicants must be Graduates or Postgraduates. Candidates currently pursuing full-time education are not eligible. The role operates in a 24x7 work environment supporting global customers and requires flexibility to work in rotational shifts and rotational week-offs. Immediate joiners will be preferred. Eligibility Criteria Fresh graduates or candidates with up to 6 Months of experience. Bachelors or Master’s degree in any discipline. Basic understanding of maps, geography, GIS, navigation, or location-based services. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently and in a team environment. Willingness to work in rotational shifts. Key Responsibilities Review, validate, and update Point of Interest (POI) information on digital mapping platforms. Verify business information such as name, address, phone number, category, operating hours, and geographic coordinates. Perform map data quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Research location data using reliable online and public sources. Identify duplicate, incorrect, and outdated map information and recommend corrections. Support geocoding and reverse geocoding activities. Analyse mapping issues and escalate complex cases when required. Meet daily productivity and quality targets. Maintain compliance with project guidelines, quality standards, and service level agreements (SLAs). Collaborate with internal teams to improve data quality and operational efficiency. Mandatory Skills Basic knowledge of Digital Maps and Navigation Systems Point of Interest (POI) Understanding Data Validation and Verification Research and Analytical Skills Attention to Detail Internet Research Basic MS Excel Communication Skills Quality Orientation Problem Solving Preferred Skills Knowledge of GIS concepts and mapping technologies. Exposure to GIS tools such as ArcGIS or QGIS through academics, projects, or internships. Basic understanding of geocoding and location intelligence concepts. Knowledge of SQL or data analysis tools will be an added advantage. Certification in GIS, Remote Sensing, or Geospatial Technologies is desirable but not mandatory. Preferred Candidate Profile Strong focus on accuracy and quality. Curious mindset with excellent research capabilities. Ability to learn new tools and technologies quickly. Good organizational and time management skills. Team player with a positive attitude. Customer-focused approach. Demonstrates ownership, accountability, and continuous learning mindset. Why Join Us? Opportunity to start a career in the growing GIS and Geospatial industry. Hands-on experience with global mapping and location intelligence projects. Exposure to leading digital mapping technologies and geospatial datasets. Structured training and learning opportunities. Collaborative and inclusive work environment. Excellent growth opportunities within GIS, Mapping, and Location Intelligence domains. Opportunity to contribute to products and services used by millions of users worldwide.

title: Human Resource Intern
description:
About the Role We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic HR Intern to join our HR team. The intern will gain practical exposure to Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Employee Engagement, and HR Documentation across our Group of Companies. This role is ideal for a candidate who is interested in building a career in Human Resources, particularly Recruitment and Talent Acquisition . Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Primary Responsibility Assist the HR team in handling end-to-end recruitment activities . Understand job requirements and assist in preparing and posting Job Descriptions. Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, employee referrals, and other recruitment channels . Screen resumes based on defined job requirements. Conduct initial candidate calls and collect relevant candidate information. Coordinate interview schedules between candidates and hiring teams. Follow up with candidates regarding interview status, feedback, offers, and joining. Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers. Assist in preparing daily/weekly recruitment MIS . Support bulk hiring, walk-in interviews, campus recruitment, and other hiring activities. Build and maintain a database of potential candidates for future requirements. 2. HR Operations Assist with employee onboarding and joining formalities. Support preparation and maintenance of employee documentation. Assist in maintaining employee records and personnel files. Support attendance and leave-related HR activities. Assist with issuing HR letters and other employee documents. Support the HR team in day-to-day administrative activities. 3. Employee Engagement Assist in organizing employee engagement activities and HR events. Support employee communication and internal HR initiatives. Assist in coordinating training programs and employee activities. Participate in various HR projects and initiatives. 4. HR MIS & Documentation Update recruitment and employee databases regularly. Maintain accurate records of candidate and employee information. Assist in preparing recruitment and HR reports. Ensure proper filing and documentation of HR records. Maintain confidentiality of employee and candidate information. 5. General HR Support Coordinate with employees, candidates, and internal departments as required. Support the HR team in implementing HR processes and initiatives. Assist with other HR-related activities assigned by the reporting manager. Required Skills Good verbal and written communication skills . Basic understanding of HR and recruitment concepts. Good interpersonal and coordination skills. Strong follow-up skills. Good organizational and time-management abilities. Basic knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets and MS Office . Willingness to learn recruitment and HR processes. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Positive attitude and professional approach. Educational Qualification Pursuing or recently completed MBA / PGDM / BBA / BBM / B.Com / BA with specialization in Human Resources or a related field. Freshers are encouraged to apply.

Key Skills: Recruitment,Screening,Sourcing,Shortlisting,Resource

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**About This Role**

**Digital Marketing Manager / Pod Manager – Client Growth \| Pod P\&L \| Escalation Leadership**

**Full\-Time \| Work From Office \| Banjara Hills, Hyderabad \| Reports to: Founder / CEO**

**Company Description**

Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven **Digital Marketing Manager / Pod Manager** with 4\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.

The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.

If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.

**What This Role Is Not**

Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title

Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls

Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution

Not a task manager or execution coordinator

Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership**

Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod

Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue

Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing

Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency

Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem

Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder

Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity

**2\. Client Growth Strategy**

Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business

Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities

Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship

Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data

Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls

Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves

Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update

**3\. Escalation Leadership**

Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues

Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence

Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward

Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently

Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation

Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level

**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management**

Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod

Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable

Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly

Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod

Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder

Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes

**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight**

Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance

Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard

Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client

Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery

Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution

**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy**

Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure

Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets

Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction

Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome

**7\. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention**

Own client retention across all pod accounts

Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times

Identify at\-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation

Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations

Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate

**Key KPIs**

Pod Revenue vs Target

Pod Gross Margin and Profitability

Client Retention Rate

Upsell and Cross\-sell Revenue Generated

Client Satisfaction Score

Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)

On\-Time Delivery Percentage

Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency

Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

4\-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency

Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross\-functional teams

Strong understanding of agency P\&L, billing, scope management, and margin control

Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing

Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently

Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients

Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal

Confident in senior client\-facing discussions and presentations

Experience with project management and reporting tools

Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast\-paced environment

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

**Agency experience is mandatory**

Has managed a revenue\-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people

Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals

Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery

Is a problem\-solver who finds solutions before escalating

Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session

**Reporting Structure**

**Reports To:** Founder / CEO

Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists

**Coordinates With:** Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team

**Escalation Authority:** Final internal point before the CEO

**Career Growth**

Senior Pod Manager → Group Account Manager → Delivery Head → Business Head

**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Work From Office, Banjara Hills, Hyderabad

Benefits: Health Insurance \| Provident Fund \| Leave Encashment

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

**Responsibilities and Duties**  
**1\. Goods \& Services Tax (GST)**

1\.1\. **Monthly Compliance**

* File GSTR\-1 and GSTR\-3B on time.
* Perform GSTR\-2B reconciliation with books.
* Match output tax and input tax entries with the Electronic Credit Ledger.
* Reconcile bank entries relating to GST with the Electronic Cash Ledger.

1\.2\. **Annual Compliance**

* Apply for Letter of Undertaking (LUT) once a year.
* File GSTR\-9 and GSTR\-9C annually.

**2\. Income Tax**

2\.1\. **Annual**

* Coordinate with statutory auditor for annual computation and tax audit filing.
* Perform final reconciliation before finalising financials.

2\.2\. **Quarterly**

* Reconcile Form 26AS with books to confirm customers have given correct TDS credits.

2\.3\. **Monthly / Transaction\-wise**

* Pass entries for TDS receivables on customer invoices to track correct credits.

**3\. Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) – Payables**

3\.1\. **Annual**

* File Form 13 in April for lower deduction certificate with required documentation.

3\.2\. **Quarterly**

* File TDS returns accurately and on time.

3\.3\. **Monthly**

* Make timely TDS payments.
* Reconcile TDS returns with books.
* Check TDS applicability on every payment before processing; do not process without confirmation.

**4\. Payroll, ESI \& PF**

4\.1\. **Monthly Payroll Processing**

* Verify correctness of Salary Data through HRMS Software; test 1–2 transactions monthly.
* Process payroll after all approvals.
* Prepare Excel workings to cross\-check software output.

4\.2\. **Attendance \& Leave**

* Verify attendance software integration with payroll.
* Maintain leave balances as per statutory requirements.

4\.3\. **Statutory Payments \& Filings**

* Make ESI and PF payments before due dates.
* File ESI and PF returns on time.
* Coordinate with consultant for UAN creation and ESI/PF portal issues.

**5\. Coordination with Consultant \& HR**

* Ensure HR provides accurate data to Consultant for statutory register maintenance.
* Cross\-check accuracy of registers.

**6\. Banking**

6\.1\. **Annual**

* Submit documents in December for OCC and term loan renewal.

6\.2\. **Monthly \& Quarterly**

* Provide monthly certificates for stock, receivables, and payables.
* Provide quarterly audited statements to bank.

6\.3\. **Ongoing**

* Maintain sufficient OCC balance for EMI on 7th of every month; alert promoters if shortfall.
* Follow up on new banking facilities.
* Visit bank weekly for pending matters.
* Verify interest charged by bank; flag discrepancies.
* Notify management of idle funds for investment planning.

**7\. Management Information System (MIS)**

7\.1\. **Daily**

* Prepare customer\-wise and cumulative daily sales reports.
* Report outstanding receivables and payables.

7\.2\. **Monthly**

* Prepare monthly P\&L and Balance Sheet with comparative figures:
* Current month vs same month previous year.
* Quarter\-to\-date vs same quarter previous year.
* Full year totals vs previous year.

**8\. SAP Implementation**

* Coordinate with factory team for smooth implementation.

**9\. Daily Accounting, Invoicing \& Vendor Management**

9\.1\. **Daily Accounting**

* Pass all accounting entries (bank, sales, vendor).
* Match entries with bank and sales invoices.

9\.2\. **Invoicing**

* Raise sales invoices daily without delay.
* Generate and upload e\-invoices as per GST rules.
* Generate and manage e\-way bills for all applicable dispatches.

9\.3\. **Vendor Invoices**

* Save vendor invoices from email day\-wise.
* Cross\-check with inwards and purchase teams before booking.
* Book only if goods are accepted for production.

9\.4\. **Payments**

* Make vendor payments strictly against invoices (no “on account” payments).
* Weekly: prepare vendor due list for payment.
* Coordinate with purchase team for payment scheduling.

**ZoTok.ai**

 ✅ Experience in B2B Sales, Inside Sales or Client Handling
   

  

 ✅ Background in Customer Success, Account Management or Onboarding
   

  

 ✅ Familiarity with SaaS, ERP, CRM tools or WhatsApp Business
   

  

 ✅ Experience in distribution, supply chain, FMCG or B2B commerce
   

  

 ✅ Strong communication and problem\-solving skills
   

  

 ✅ Startup mindset — ownership, hustle and hunger to grow
   

  

**Experience:** 
 0 to 10 years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad — Work From Office
   

  

 Apply to the job, and shortlisted candidates will receive a
 **personal invitation** 
 to the Walk\-In Drive on 19th September. Only invited candidates will be interviewed.
   

  

**What To Bring On The Day**
 📄 Updated Resume
   

  

 Don't wait — apply now and secure your spot!
   

  

 🌐 Know more: www.zotok.ai
   

  

**About Zotok**
 ZoTok, part of Zono Tradetech Pvt Ltd, is an AI\-powered conversational commerce platform that turns WhatsApp into a business automation engine. We help brands, manufacturers, distributors, and retailers streamline their order\-to\-cash processes using AI and WhatsApp Business. We are building India's first Network CRM for conversational commerce — powered by Agentic AI and already 2,000\+ demos delivered in the last 6 months alone.
   

  

**SALES**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Sales Specialist to drive revenue through consultative B2B selling. You'll work with brands, manufacturers, distributors, and wholesalers — understanding their operational bottlenecks and positioning ZoTok as the fix.
   

  

 This is a 100% inside sales role from our Hyderabad office — no field work. Every business you speak with has a different pain point. Your job is to diagnose it fast and close the deal.
   

  

**The Basics**
 Experience: 2\-10 years
   

  

 Location: Hyderabad \- Office Based, 5 days WFO
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own the cycle: Drive the full sales cycle from lead qualification to closure — calls, demos, follow\-ups, negotiations and deal closure.
* Run demos: Conduct sharp discovery calls and product demos with qualified prospects. We have completed 2,000\+ demos in the last 6 months — you will add to that.
* Understand deeply: Get into customer workflows around orders, invoices, payments, ERP and supply chain — then position ZoTok's AI and WhatsApp automation as the solution.
* Stay on top: Manage outreach and follow\-ups across WhatsApp, email and calls. Build and maintain a healthy pipeline with accurate CRM updates.
* Close \& grow: Handle objections, negotiate confidently and drive opportunities to closure. Work closely with internal teams to move deals forward.


**What Matters More Than The Resume**
* Clarity on Calls \& Chats: You can hold a live call and drive a WhatsApp thread with absolute sharpness to keep deals moving.
* Consultative Pitching: You think on your feet, diagnose unique business bottlenecks instantly, and position WhatsApp automation as the fix.
* Industry Context: B2B, distribution, FMCG/GT, supply chain, or SaaS — you already know how brands move goods to market.
* Ownership: Strong problem\-solving, follow\-through and execution. You don't wait to be told — you drive.


**Essesntial Skills**
* Experience: 2–7 years in B2B, SaaS, ERP, fintech or technology sales.
* Selling: Consultative selling, objection handling, pipeline management and closures.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication with business users and decision\-makers.
* Plus: ERP, SaaS, payments, invoicing, supply chain, FMCG, distribution or WhatsApp/AI background is a strong advantage.


**CUSTOMER SUCCESS**
**About the Role:** 
 We’re expanding our Customer Success team at ZöTok with 10\+ open positions. We are building India’s first network CRM for conversational commerce, and your job is to ensure our clients actually adopt and see massive value from our Agentic AI on WhatsApp Business.
   

  

 As part of the Customer Success team at ZoTok, you will play a critical role in ensuring our clients adopt, implement and derive maximum value from our platform. This is not a passive support role — you are expected to own accounts end to end, drive technical delivery, manage stakeholders, and grow revenue through upsells and expansions.
   

  

 We are hiring across multiple sub\-roles within Customer Success — from onboarding and activation to key account management and technical project delivery. Each role requires a combination of technical aptitude, commercial instinct and strong client relationship skills.
   

  

**The Basics**
* Experience: 2 to 10 years
* Early joiners preferred.


**Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Onboarding \& Implementation
* Own end\-to\-end client onboarding — from contract closure to first bill generation and successful product adoption.
* Understand client business requirements and configure, customize and integrate ZoTok within their existing systems.
* Manage technical project delivery including timelines, milestones and go\-live planning.
* Work with integration tools including Postman, APIs and ERP connectors to ensure seamless setup.
* Account Management \& Revenue
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts — building strong, long\-lasting relationships with decision\-makers.
* Monitor account health scores, product usage and adoption metrics using Odoo and internal CRM tools.
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities post\-onboarding and drive revenue expansion.
* Own and manage revenue responsibility for assigned accounts — retention and growth are your KPIs.
* Sell 'Done\-for\-You' models where you directly drive business outcomes for clients using ZoTok.
* Technical \& Product
* Conduct product demonstrations tailored to client\-specific needs and industry workflows.
* Perform QA and UAT validation during implementation to ensure product is configured correctly.
* Gather and document client requirements using BA methodologies — BRDs, user stories and process maps.
* Collaborate with internal Tech, Product and Integration teams to resolve client issues promptly.
* Stakeholder Management
* Manage internal pushback from client\-side blockers and influencers who fear automation — convince them ZoTok makes their work easier.
* Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) with key stakeholders and present performance reports.
* Provide training to client teams to ensure they are fully equipped to use ZoTok independently.
* Serve as a trusted advisor — not just a support contact — throughout the client journey.


**What Are We Looking For**
* Experience \& Background
* 2–10 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Onboarding, Technical Project Delivery or similar roles in IT/SaaS industry.
* Experience with ERP platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Odoo or similar is a strong advantage.
* Background in technical implementation, SaaS onboarding or BA roles is highly preferred.
* Working experience in Distribution, Supply Chain or B2B Commerce industries is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree mandatory — negotiable for candidates with strong relevant experience.
* Technical Skills
* Familiarity with Postman, REST APIs and integration workflows.
* Experience with QA processes, UAT and product testing.
* Proficiency in CRM tools — Salesforce, Odoo, HubSpot or similar.
* Basic understanding of ERP workflows — SAP, Tally, Zoho or similar.
* Ability to read and interpret API documentation and integration specs.
* Soft Skills \& Mindset
* Commercial Instinct — you don't just support clients, you spot expansion opportunities and drive upsells naturally.
* Stakeholder Management — you can hold a room, manage pushback and get buy\-in from skeptical decision\-makers.
* Ownership Mindset — you drive tasks to completion without being told and think proactively about what comes next.
* Communication — excellent verbal and written communication with clients, leadership and internal teams.
* Adaptability — ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth startup environment.


**What Matters More Than The Resume**
* Stakeholder Management \& Persuasion: You can hold a room and manage pushback from insecure internal influencers who fear automation.
* Technical — Postman, REST APIs, QA/UAT, CRM tools (Salesforce, Odoo), ERP background (SAP, Tally, Zoho) — advantage.
* Domain — Supply chain, distribution, B2B commerce or SaaS implementation background — strongly preferred.
* Mindset — Commercial instinct, ownership, stakeholder management and hunger to make clients genuinely successful.
* Commercial Instinct: You don't just support clients; you spot expansion opportunities and naturally drive upsells post\-onboarding.
* Industry \& SaaS Context: Deep familiarity with supply chain, distribution, or B2B SaaS workflows to guide clients.


**Why Join ZoTok?**
 At ZoTok, you won't be managing accounts — you will be shaping how India's businesses operate on WhatsApp. You'll work at the intersection of AI, commerce and technology, building something that has never been done before in India.
   

  

* Be part of India's first Network CRM for conversational commerce — a category\-defining product.
* Work directly with Brands, Distributors and Retailers across India's $1 trillion\+ General Trade ecosystem.
* Deep domain expertise in Supply Chain Management and B2B SaaS — skills that compound over time.
* Fast\-paced, ownership\-driven culture where your impact is visible and rewarded.
* Opportunity to grow into senior leadership as we scale rapidly across India and globally.


*ZoTok occupies a niche market with tremendous demand. Join us and be part of something truly extraordinary — redefining Conversational Commerce in India and beyond.*

title: Walk-in || Staff Nurse -  Nephroplus International Dialysis Academy
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 11 Sep - 30 Sep
Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: #89, 5th Cross Road, Behind Police Station, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru – 560003
Contact: Chandan S (8660859024)

nephroplus 
 Staff Nurse Graduate Trainee (Freshers) 
 Campus Recruitment Drive 2026 | Locations Across India 
 About NephroPlus 
 NephroPlus is India's largest network of dialysis centers, providing high-quality, affordable kidney care to patients 
 across the country. With a strong presence across states and a mission to make world-class kidney care accessible, 
 NephroPlus combines clinical excellence with compassionate patient care. We invest heavily in training our clinical 
 teams, and our Staff Nurse program is designed specifically to help nursing graduates build a specialized, rewarding 
 career in nephrology and critical care nursing even with no prior dialysis experience. 
 Role Overview 
 As a Staff Nurse (Graduate Trainee) at NephroPlus, you will be the primary caregiver for patients undergoing dialysis 
 treatment. You will work under the guidance of the Unit In-Charge and Senior Therapist, receiving structured, hands- 
 on training in dialysis science, machine operation, water treatment monitoring, and direct patient care. This is an 
 excellent opportunity for freshers to specialize early in a high-demand clinical field, with clear pathways to grow into 
 Senior Staff Nurse, Sr. Therapist, and Unit In-Charge roles. 
 Why Join NephroPlus 
 No prior dialysis experience required complete, structured induction training provided through NephroPlus 
 Academy 
 Certification in dialysis care on successful completion of training 
 ¢ Hands-on mentorship from experienced Unit In-Charges and Senior Therapists 
 ¢
 Defined career growth path: Staff Nurse Senior Staff Nurse Sr. Therapist Unit In-Charge 
 ¢ Exposure to critical care skills vascular access management, emergency response, CPR, and patient 
 monitoring 
 ¢ Opportunities to work across a pan-India network of centers 
 ¢ International deployment opportunities for high-performing nurses at NephroPlus centers overseas 
 ¢ Competitive fresher stipend/CTC with statutory benefits (PF, insurance) 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Clinical & Technical Care 
 ¢ Assemble necessary supplies and prepare the dialyzer according to established procedures and the dialysis 
 prescription 
 ¢ Assemble and prepare the dialysis extracorporeal circuit as per protocol and prescription 
 ¢ Verify absence of residual sterilants before use 
 ¢ Test and monitor machine functions including alarms, conductivity, and temperature; set alarms per unit and 
 manufacturer protocol 
 ¢ Verify dialyzer details and complete related documentation 
 ¢ Discard used supplies and sanitize equipment as per manufacturer and unit protocol 
 ¢ Monitor RO (water treatment) readings to ensure safe limits and adequate water levels for subsequent shifts; 
 document readings accurately 
 2. Direct Patient Care 
 ¢ Record pre- and post-dialysis vital signs, weight, and temperature 
 
 
 
 ¢ Inspect the patient's dialysis access; administer local anesthesia where required and insert needles per protocol 
 and prescription 
 ¢ Document treatment parameters and promptly communicate any patient concerns to the Unit In-Charge 
 ¢ Administer anticoagulants and adjust blood flow and fluid removal rates as per protocol and physician 
 prescription 
 ¢ Safely discontinue dialysis, establish hemostasis, and clean/dress the access site as per protocol 
 ¢ Continuously monitor patients and equipment, responding to alarms and adjusting treatment as required 
 ¢ Respond appropriately to dialysis-related emergencies hypotension, needle displacement, clotting, blood 
 leaks, or air embolism 
 ¢ Initiate CPR in the event of a cardiac emergency 
 ¢ Support patient education on nutrition, lifestyle, and treatment adherence, in collaboration with the Unit In- 
 Charge and Sr. Therapist 
 ¢ Communicate emotional, medical, psychosocial, and nutritional concerns of patients to the Unit In-Charge 
 ¢ Maintain professional conduct, empathetic communication, and patient confidentiality at all times 
 3. Process, Quality & Compliance 
 ¢ Accurately update patient vitals and dialysis data in Electronic Medical Records or designated registers 
 ¢ Ensure adherence to NABH standards and other applicable clinical quality protocols 
 ¢ Ensure reprocessing and dilution procedures are carried out strictly as per unit protocol 
 ¢ Maintain overall hygiene and support proper waste management within the dialysis unit 
 4. Team & Facility Support 
 ¢ Assist in preparing patient treatment schedules alongside the care team 
 ¢ Support training of new team members on dialysis machine preparation, monitoring, and maintenance 
 ¢ Report any protocol deviations observed among staff to the Unit In-Charge 
 ¢ Help maintain minimum stock levels in the emergency trolley and check it daily 
 ¢ Ensure facilities and supplies for emergency resuscitation are always ready 
 ¢ Support adequate staffing coordination to ensure uninterrupted patient care 
 Eligibility Criteria 
 Qualification 
 Registration 
 B.Sc Nursing from a recognized institution (mandatory) 
 Valid registration with the respective State Nursing Council (mandatory before 
 joining, or in progress) 
 Experience 
 Freshers and final-semester/final-year students are welcome to apply no 
 prior dialysis experience required 
 Age 
 2028 years 
 Language 
 Proficiency in the local regional language of the posting location; working 
 knowledge of English 
 Work Conditions 
 Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including weekends, and to relocate 
 within the region (or internationally, where applicable) if required 
 Skills & Attributes We Look For 
 ¢ Genuine empathy and a patient-first attitude 
 ¢ Strong attention to detail and adherence to clinical protocols 
 
 
 
 ¢ Clear communication skills, both with patients and team members 
 ¢ Composure and quick thinking in emergency situations 
 ¢ Willingness to learn and adapt to specialized clinical protocols 
 ¢ Basic computer literacy for maintaining electronic medical records 
 ¢ Team orientation and reliability 
 Training & Career Growth 
 All selected freshers go through a structured induction program at the NephroPlus Academy, covering the scientific 
 principles of dialysis, machine operation, water treatment monitoring, patient safety, and emergency response. The 
 program combines classroom learning with supervised, on-the-job training at a NephroPlus center, culminating in a 
 certification in dialysis care. High performers have a clear path to progress into Senior Staff Nurse, Sr. Therapist, and 
 Unit In-Charge roles within the organization, including opportunities for international deployment.

Key Skills: Patient Care,Hemodialysis,Dialysis,Hospital,Nursing,International

description:
**Academy Front Desk Administrator** 

**About Muzigal**

Muzigal was founded in the year 2020 by Dr. Lakshminarayana Yeluri, a serial Entrepreneur and Musician, with a vision to make high\-quality music education accessible and affordable by connecting huge untapped music teaching talent with aspiring learners through its app and offline academies. Within 24 months of its inception, Muzigal has served over 24,000 students and more than 400 teachers. Muzigal is the first\-ever organised player revolutionising the music education space globally. Muzigal has emerged as a dominant player in the last 18 months and has become the largest destination for music teachers and students.

Muzigal offers beginners to intermediate level music classes across Indian and Western music genres for all age groups through its proprietary curriculum delivered by qualified music teachers. Muzigal currently operates several offline academies across India and is expanding its footprint rapidly to become a household name for music learning in India and globally. The brand plans to expand to 100\+ academies across India within the next 18 months.

**Role Overview**

The Counsellor \& Admin at Muzigal Academy is a full\-time and multi\-functional position. The incumbent reports to the Academy Owner. S/he plays a pivotal role in managing sales \& marketing activities at the front desk that include making calls and responding to queries, ensuring steady stream of walkins, maintaining CRM Hygiene, undertaking walk\-in management tasks \- conduct academy tour, scheduling demo with Faculty, communicating with the walkin to ensure enrollment. In the Admin role the incumbent is required to manage day to day tasks of running facilities such as \- ensure opening and closing routines as per company SOP, maintain and manage inventory \- Forms, Info Leaflets and Brochures, Instruments \& Accessories, Books, , ensure display of instruments and follow the SOPS and guidelines prescribed by the Company.

**Responsibilities**

* Ensuring the Academy opens and closes as per timings and associated opening and closing routines strictly implemented such \- cleanliness,
* Keeping the frontdesk walkin ready to efficiently manage the counselling and enrollment processes \- Forms, Brochures,Desktop PoS and so on,
* Establishing rapport with the walkins and obtaining their relevant information to help in the right choice of course.
* Counselling the prospects on making the right choice of music learning through the various Muzigal information collaterals.
* Introduce the learning structures through Muzigal Preparatory Curriculum Framework and explain the learning progression Learn\> Play \> Inspire
* Ensuring Facility is managed efficiently as per company protocol
* Running daily checklist \- Day opening/ Closing,
* Ensuring inventory levels of stationary, pantry and other day to day supplies and services are satisfactorily maintained. Reordering if necessary.
* Maintain and manage vendor list for purchases, Payments, replacements and maintenance of facility.
* Ensure all Academy checklists are verified – cleaning and ambiance checklist , sterilisation checklist, toilet checklist, etc.
* Ensure that the Academy is running smoothly at all times
* Conduct outbound calls to prospective students and parents to provide information about the academy's courses and offerings.
* Achieve and exceed weekly/monthly sales targets through effective telephonic communication and follow\-up.
* Implement sales strategies to convert leads into enrollments.
* Provide regular reports on tele calling and sales activities.
* Keeping the CRM updated for the Muzigal academy
* Be willing to work extra hours and on holidays if required.
* Any other duties as assigned by the reporting manager.

**Education and Skills Required**

* High School / Graduate
* Strong communication and people skills
* Knowledge of office management and basic book\-keeping
* Excellent knowledge of MS Office applications (especially Excel and Word)
* Good organisational and multitasking abilities
* Problem\-solving skills

Raise and participate in deviations, change controls, CAPA, incident investigations and risk assessments; investigate abnormal trends and support corrective and preventive actions. Use TrackWise QMS and Document Management System (DMS) to support compliance with the Quality Management System. 
 4. Audit Readiness & SAP Support Maintain utility/HVAC systems in an audit-ready condition in line with applicable cGMP, WHO-GMP, Schedule M, EU-GMP and USFDA requirements. Use SAP for PR, material-code creation, service entry and related engineering transactions as required.

 GTM Intern
